title: DNF bounds for a decision tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a decision tree that queries only coordinates in $A$ and has sign-valued outputs. The function on $\{−1,1\}^n$ obtained by evaluating $T$ on the coordinatewise binary encoding has a disjunctive normal form with at most as many terms as $T$ has leaves, and with every term containing at most $\mathrm{depth}(T)$ literals.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of coordinates among $n$ coordinates
$T$ is a decision tree indexed by available coordinates $A$ with sign-valued outputs
